frontmatter.sidebar_description: Add outbound or new items to a claim.

blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `orderClaimAddNewItemWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This workflow adds outbound (or new) items to a claim. It's used by the
[Add Outbound Items Admin API Route](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#claims\_postclaimsidoutbounditems).

You can use this workflow within your customizations or your own custom workflows, allowing you to add outbound items to a claim
in your custom flows.

steps.name: orderClaimAddNewItemValidationStep
steps.description:
This step validates that new items can be added to the claim. If the
order or claim is canceled, or the order change is not active, the step will throw an error.

:::note

You can retrieve an order, order claim, and order change details using [Query](https://docs.medusajs.com/learn/fundamentals/module-links/query),
or [useQueryGraphStep](https://docs.medusajs.com/resources/references/medusa-workflows/steps/useQueryGraphStep).

:::
